unnecessary_requirements: Student Management: no need to build this within IMS, integrate IMS with CAMU instead for student profiles. It should simply read this data via an API or single sign-on (SSO) token, maintaining only an associative internship state for that student. Internship Status Tracking is a subset of Internship Management. Authentication & RBAC can be merged
improvement_suggestions: Clarify authentication by specifying how users will log in, recover passwords, and manage sessions. Role Management should also be detailed by identifying the exact users, such as admin, coordinator, student, and HTE supervisor, and defining what each role is allowed to access or modify. Internship Management needs the most clarification because it is too broad. Improve Attendance Management by explaining how time logs are submitted, approved, corrected, and computed. Security should include specific controls such as role-based access, secure file storage, and data protection. Reliability should mention backups, data recovery, and data accuracy. Usability should clarify that the system must be simple, accessible, and easy to navigate. Compliance should specify the CHED or institutional internship requirements, reports, and records that the system must support.
missing_features: Consider including internship application and approval management, where students can apply for available internship opportunities and coordinators or HTE supervisors can approve, reject, or shortlist applications. Add notification and reminder features to inform users about pending approvals, missing documents, attendance deadlines, evaluation schedules, and internship completion requirements. Internship posting or opportunity management, where HTEs or coordinators can post available internship slots, job descriptions, qualifications, schedules, and required skills. include supervisor assignment and monitoring, allowing coordinators to assign HTE supervisors or faculty advisers to students and monitor their progress throughout the internship period. consider adding document approval workflow, not just document upload. This means documents can be marked as pending, approved, rejected, or needing resubmission. Another missing feature is certificate or completion clearance generation, where the system can verify attendance hours, documents, and evaluations before marking a student as completed. Add a Dashboard feature would be useful for students, coordinators, administrators, and HTEs. It can show quick summaries such as number of assigned interns, pending documents, completed hours, ongoing internships, and evaluation status.

unnecessary_requirements:

improvement_suggestions:

Reporting: specify if customizable dashboards and export formats (PDF, Excel) are supported.
Notifications: define channels (email, SMS, in-app) and escalation rules.
missing_features: Integration with existing LMS or ERP systems for seamless data flow. Mobile accessibility for students and supervisors. Analytics for internship outcomes (completion rates, performance trends).
comments: Prioritize scalability so the system can expand to multiple campuses. Strong emphasis on security and audit logging is commendable.
